limits: Committed WebAssembly capacity is not allocator-used bytes and does not shrink when allocations are freed.
Four same-study cycles detect retained guards and capacity growth at the recorded phases; no unbounded-duration leak claim.
Chromium performance.memory is sampled without forced garbage collection; its variable heap counters are evidence, not a growth gate. Firefox reports this API unavailable, not zero.
File chooser selection and Chromium CDP file-backed drops are automated input, not physical file-manager drag.
No WebKit, process-tree, compositor, GPU, or matched-framework resource comparison in this run.
